client_snippets.title: OpenAI Python SDK
client_snippets.template:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="{openai_base_url}", api_key="{api_key}")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="bubo",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

client_snippets.title: Anthropic Python SDK
client_snippets.template:
from anthropic import Anthropic

client = Anthropic(base_url="{anthropic_base_url}", auth_token="{api_key}")
response = client.messages.create(
    model="bubo", max_tokens=128,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(response.content)
